diag.txt: Graduated in the same second it was created: the bundle bought the whole bonding curve — nobody outside could buy before it hit the pool.
Selling: the early wallets have sold 88.9% of supply so far, 7.8% of it in the last hour (35 wallets); 33 sold in the last 30 min.
GMGN tags 2 holders as bundler or insider; 0 of them are also in our bundle / owner groups.
Bundles: GMGN says bundlers bought 0.9% and hold 1.5% now; we measure 89.5% bought together and 0.0% still held.

Exchange-funded wallet farm: 17 fresh launch wallets got their first SOL from exchanges (MEXC, unnamed busy wallet, Kucoin Wallet, Bitget) within 173 min, about 17.8 h before launch — the usual way to hide that one person owns them. They hold 0.0% now.

Probably the same owner as the dev / bundle (not proven): 25 wallets tied to them only by weaker signs — exchange withdrawals of near-identical amounts at the same time, one busy wallet paying several of them, or identical buy sizes together; they hold 10.5% now.
Heavily bundled: 79.6% of supply bought in the create block over 19 wallets.
19 of the early wallets are trading in and out of the coin (3+ buys and 3+ sells) — volume farming or flipping.
Last 100 trades: 48 buying wallets; 35 of 48 checked are fresh, putting in 9.28 of 9.9 SOL.
Launch checked against our tracker's live record: both see 79.6% bought in the create block by 19 wallets.
Liquidity: 208.5 SOL in the pool; 100.0% of the LP tokens are burned — the liquidity cannot be pulled.
Followed the SOL out of 70 selling dev / bundle / early wallets (383 transfers, 1 into exchanges): none of it came back into this coin within two steps.
The dev and bundle's group (19 wallets including wallets linked to them) holds 0.0% now.
Dev bought 0.2% and holds none now (sold out).
Bundle wallets: took 79.4% in the create block, hold 0.0% now; 18 of 18 sold out.
The first 60 buyers after the dev and bundle (all within 86 s of launch) bought 15.7%; together with the dev and bundle 17 wallets still hold 10.5%. Fresh: 37 of 79 checked, holding 0.0%.
3 of the early wallets are whales (50+ SOL or $10K+ in tokens), holding 0.0% now.
Snipers (4 blocks after the create): 8 took 13.9%, hold 0.0% now.
Top 10 holders (pool and curve left out) hold 7.5%; the largest 0.8%.
The bundle's first sales were at about $358K–$574K market cap (today's SOL price).
No other coins from this dev wallet.
The dev wallet was funded by ASTyfS… with 0.07 SOL (MEXC, an exchange — GMGN).
Creator wallet was 20.6 h old at launch.
39 funders are busy, exchange-like wallets; wallets that share only that funder were not grouped together.
